quote: SQuALITY summaries are created by having trained writers read short stories, then ask questions about different aspects of the story. The writers then answer the questions by writing summaries focusing on that aspect.
We present SQuALITY, a long-input dataset for abstractive question-focused summarization... We evaluate supervised sequence-to-sequence models on SQuALITY using different pretrained language models.
